name: Faith Loss is Doubled/Gains Halved
description: Every believer's Faith moves each age unit by a few small rolls (New Believers' own Faith drift). This doubles the chance of every roll that takes Faith away and halves the chance of every roll that gives it: food under 10 loses 1 Faith 60% of the time (was 30%), and when that misses, 20% (was 10%); food 10 to 250 loses 1 Faith 20% of the time (was 10%); a sick believer loses 1 more 30% of the time (was 15%); fewer than 12 believers loses 1 with a chance of 2 x (12 - believers) in 100 (was 12 - believers). Food 8,000 or more gains 1 Faith 10% of the time (was 20%); the Tribute Statue solved 15% (was 30%; its first and second stages 5% and 10%, were 10% and 20%); Spirituality 1, 2 or 3 gains 5%, 10% or 15% (was 10%, 20% or 30%); 12 or more believers gains 1 with a chance of believers / 10 in 100 (was believers / 5). A fall is no longer skipped half the time when Faith is below 5, so a believer can fall all the way to 0 and become a Heathen, as in the stock game at 0; a rise above 75 is still skipped 70% of the time. Believers in a crisis mostly stay and die rather than leave: a Heathen never eats, starves or falls ill. There are four crises, each with its own roll: starvation (food under 10), hunger (food 10 to 250), sickness, and too few believers (fewer than 12, the babies they carry counted). The first time one of them would take a believer's last Faith, it is decided once for that believer and that crisis: 1 in 20 becomes a Heathen for starvation, 1 in 25 for sickness, 1 in 50 for hunger and 1 in 50 for too few believers; the others stay believers, and that crisis never takes them below Faith 1 again, so they go on facing hunger and sickness as usual and can starve or die of illness. Each crisis ends on its own: starvation and hunger when food is above 250 again, sickness when the villager is cured, too few believers when there are 12 or more believers again; a later crisis of that kind is decided afresh. It is remembered through saving and loading, by the patch's own file in the save's folder. Preaching, Spreading the Word, island events and every other Faith change are unchanged. Adds a real chance of your villagers becoming heathens. Makes the game that much harder. Good Luck!
behavior_changes: The Faith drift 0x468040 (each believer, once per age unit, live and while catching up; Heathens skipped at 0x472CB7): every loss roll's rand(100) threshold doubled, every gain roll's halved, and the 50% skip of a fall below Faith 5 (0x4681A7) removed. The rise skip above 75 (70%) is unchanged.
A believer whose Faith reaches 0 or less becomes a Heathen in the setter 0x467F90, exactly as in the stock game.

Believers in a crisis mostly stay rather than leave, decided once per villager per cause per crisis. The four loss sites (food 0x46805E, 0x46807E; sickness 0x4680BB; too few believers 0x468184) say in ebp which losses the drift made. VVFP Faith Loss.dll (at the tail cave's call 0x494F14, before the FAITH_ADD 0x4681DB) takes the gains first and then the losses in the drift's order (food -- starvation under 10, hunger 10 to 250 -- then sickness, then too few believers); the loss that would take the last Faith is that cause's: decided once on rand(N) < 1 -- N 20 for starvation, 25 for sickness, 50 for hunger and 50 for too few believers (the owner, 2026-11-22) -- (the fall is made, a Heathen), else the villager is marked for that cause; a cause the villager is marked for never takes them below Faith 1. The life tick goes on with its hunger and sickness (0x472D66 on) as for any believer.

Each cause's mark clears on its own at the villager's next drift: starvation and hunger when food is above 250, sickness when not sick (+0x1C48), too few believers when the game's own count (0x4713F0, the manager the drift names at 0x46815F) is 12 or more.

The marks are kept by villager identity (name, likes and dislikes), with the causes, in <save folder>\Virtual Villagers Fun Patcher\Save <S>\Data\Faith Loss\Believers Kept - Save <S>.dat, written when a mark is made or cleared and read for the slot the game loads (before its catch-up); only living believers are kept. A version 1 file (one mark for food and sickness) is read as marked for starvation, hunger and sickness. Start Over deletes it with the save's folder.
Without the companion the cave's own rule (0x494F28) decides each fall to 0 or less alone: 1 in 10 converts, else Faith 1.
explicit_non_changes: Thirteen immediates and branches inside the routine, its entry, four loss sites, its last call and its epilogue; three caves in the .text tail (0x494F00, 0x494F14, 0x494F28). The routine's rolls, their order and the Faith they move are the stock ones but for the once-a-crisis decision added after them. No save or villager-record byte is written.
Starting Faith, preaching, Spreading the Word, the Heathen Doctor's cure, The Heathen Chief, the Hydroponic Farm, the Heathen Mommy's puzzle and island events are unchanged.

patches.purpose: food under 10: -1 on rand(100) < 30 -> < 60
food 10..250 (and food under 10 when its first roll missed): -1 on rand(100) < 10 -> < 20
food 8,000 or more: +1 on rand(100) < 20 -> < 10
a sick believer: -1 on rand(100) < 15 -> < 30
the Tribute Statue solved: +1 on rand(100) < 30 -> < 15
the statue's second stage: +1 on rand(100) < 20 -> < 10
the statue's first stage: +1 on rand(100) < 10 -> < 5
Spirituality 3: +1 on rand(100) < 30 -> < 15
Spirituality 2: +1 on rand(100) < 20 -> < 10
Spirituality 1: +1 on rand(100) < 10 -> < 5
fewer than 12 believers: -1 on rand(100) < 12 - n -> imul ecx,edi,-2 / add ecx,24 / cmp eax,ecx: < 2 * (12 - n)
12 or more believers: +1 on rand(100) < n / 5 -> sar edx,2: < n / 10 (n is positive here, so the sign fix-up is not needed)
a fall with Faith under 5 was skipped on rand(100) < 50: jge -> jmp, never skipped
the drift's entry (push ebx; push esi; xor esi,esi; cmp [food],10) -> jmp the entry cave 0x494F00, which also saves and zeroes ebp, which losses the drift made (FAITH_LOSS_MARKS)
food under 10, the roll hit: or esi,-1 -> dec esi; inc ebp (ebp bit 0: a food loss); the jmp is kept
food 10..250 (or under 10 when its first roll missed), the roll hit: or esi,-1 -> dec esi; inc ebp
a sick believer, the roll hit: sub esi,1 -> dec esi; inc ebp; inc ebp (ebp bit 1: the sickness loss)
fewer than 12 believers, the roll hit: sub esi,1 -> dec esi; not ebp (ebp < 0: too few believers' loss, ~ebp the food and sickness bits); the jmp is kept
the drift's FAITH_ADD (push esi; mov ecx,ebx; call 0x468020) -> jmp the tail cave 0x494F14
the drift's epilogue: pop esi; pop ebx; ret -> pop ebp; pop esi; pop ebx; ret (into the int3 padding after it)
the entry cave: push ebx; push esi; push ebp; esi = 0; ebp = 0; cmp [food],10; jmp back to 0x46804B
the tail cave: call the rule (0x494F28; VVFP Faith Loss.dll redirects this call to its per-villager rule), then FAITH_ADD(esi) and the epilogue
the rule without the companion: a fall (esi < 0) that takes Faith to 0 or less is made on rand(10) < 1; otherwise esi = 1 - Faith (the believer stays at Faith 1)

runtime_detours.routine: the Faith drift's tail cave: its call of the rule goes to the companion's per-villager rule (the marks)
runtime_detours.installed_by: VVFP Faith Loss.dll, VvfpStartup (started by VVFP Startup.dll, second word)
